mapper.select: SELECT r.RESERVATION_ID, r.USER_ID, r.ASSET_ID, r.START_TIME, r.END_TIME, r.PURPOSE, r.STATUS, r.ADDRESS, r.ADDRESS_STATE, r.ADDRESS_CITY, r.CREATED_AT, r.COMPLETED_AT, r.USAGE_DURATION, r.ADMIN_ID, r.IS_REJECTED, r.REJECT_REASON, a.NAME as ASSET_NAME, a.CATEGORY as ASSET_CATEGORY, a.COMPANY as ASSET_COMPANY, a.IMAGE as ASSET_IMAGE, u.name as ADMIN_NAME FROM RESERVATION r JOIN ASSET a ON r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID LEFT JOIN USERS u ON r.ADMIN_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.IS_DELETED = 'N' ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT r.RESERVATION_ID, r.USER_ID, r.ASSET_ID, r.START_TIME, r.END_TIME, r.PURPOSE, r.STATUS, r.ADDRESS, r.ADDRESS_STATE, r.ADDRESS_CITY, r.CREATED_AT, r.COMPLETED_AT, r.USAGE_DURATION, r.ADMIN_ID, r.IS_REJECTED, r.REJECT_REASON, a.NAME as ASSET_NAME, a.CATEGORY as ASSET_CATEGORY, a.COMPANY as ASSET_COMPANY, a.IMAGE as ASSET_IMAGE, u.name as ADMIN_NAME FROM RESERVATION r JOIN ASSET a ON r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID LEFT JOIN USERS u ON r.ADMIN_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND r.STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'COMPLETED') AND (r.IS_REJECTED IS NULL OR r.IS_REJECTED = 'N') AND ( r.COMPLETED_AT IS NOT NULL OR (r.START_TIME <= SYSDATE AND r.END_TIME > SYSDATE) OR r.END_TIME <= SYSDATE ) ORDER BY r.START_TIME DESC

SELECT r.RESERVATION_ID, r.USER_ID, r.ASSET_ID, r.START_TIME, r.END_TIME, r.PURPOSE, r.STATUS, r.ADDRESS, r.ADDRESS_STATE, r.ADDRESS_CITY, r.CREATED_AT, r.COMPLETED_AT, r.USAGE_DURATION, r.ADMIN_ID, r.IS_REJECTED, r.REJECT_REASON, a.NAME as ASSET_NAME, a.CATEGORY as ASSET_CATEGORY, a.COMPANY as ASSET_COMPANY, a.IMAGE as ASSET_IMAGE, u.name as ADMIN_NAME FROM RESERVATION r JOIN ASSET a ON r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID LEFT JOIN USERS u ON r.ADMIN_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE r.RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND a.IS_DELETED = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE RESERVATION SET STATUS = 'CANCELLED', IS_REJECTED = 'Y', REJECT_REASON = '사용자 취소' WHERE RESERVATION_ID = #{reservationId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING' AND (IS_REJECTED IS NULL OR IS_REJECTED = 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'COMPLETED') THEN 1 END) as totalUsageCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'COMPLETED' OR COMPLETED_AT IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as completedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND START_TIME <= SYSDATE AND END_TIME > SYSDATE AND COMPLETED_AT IS NULL THEN 1 END) as activeCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'APPROVED' AND END_TIME < SYSDATE AND COMPLETED_AT IS NULL THEN 1 END) as overdueCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN USAGE_DURATION IS NOT NULL THEN USAGE_DURATION ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalUsageMinutes, NVL(AVG(CASE WHEN USAGE_DURATION IS NOT NULL THEN USAGE_DURATION ELSE NULL END), 0) as avgUsageMinutes FROM RESERVATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as pendingCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as approvedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) as rejectedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) as completedCount FROM RESERVATION WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT DISTINCT a.ASSET_ID, a.NAME as ASSET_NAME, a.CATEGORY as ASSET_CATEGORY, a.COMPANY as ASSET_COMPANY, a.IMAGE as ASSET_IMAGE, MAX(r.START_TIME) as LAST_USED_DATE FROM RESERVATION r JOIN ASSET a ON r.ASSET_ID = a.ASSET_ID WHERE r.USER_ID = #{userId} AND r.STATUS IN ('APPROVED', 'COMPLETED') AND (r.IS_REJECTED IS NULL OR r.IS_REJECTED = 'N') AND r.START_TIME <= SYSDATE AND a.IS_DELETED = 'N' GROUP BY a.ASSET_ID, a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY, a.IMAGE ORDER BY LAST_USED_DATE DESC
FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
